entities.summary: The Jāmeh Mosque of Zanjān, also known as the Seyyed Mosque and the Sultani Mosque, is a Shi'ite Friday mosque (jāmeh) and madrasa, located in the city of Zanjān, Zanjān county, in the province of Zanjān, Iran. The mosque is situated in the old part of the city and was constructed in 1826 CE, during the Qajar era.
